insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 35/88 games (40%): 6 picks (0-6) and 29 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rumble? They go Sion
insights.text: Rumble is a G1 favorite (13/36 G1s, played by DuDu). In the 37 later games where it was burned or banned, DuDu went to Sion (8/37) and K'Sante (7/37).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 16 G3+ games, 23/80 picks (29%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 60 champs in G1s, 51 in G3+.
